title: Lockheed Martin coherent matter wave beam patent

tellings.quote: Um there's a Lockheed Martin patent called a coherent matter wave beam that deals with using the Aharonov-Bohm

plain: The defence company Lockheed Martin is said to hold a patent called a "coherent matter wave beam" that uses the Aharonov-Bohm effect, a quantum effect in which particles are influenced by electromagnetic forces in places where no field seems to be present. A man named Dave Rossi, who says he learned advanced physics from aliens, mentions the patent to Michels without saying where he found it. He brings it up as a sign that a major defence contractor is working on the same unusual physics he talks about.
